title: Security Deposit Account Settlement Allowance Ceiling by How Early the Payment Is Made
content:
The ceiling on the settlement allowance of a Security Deposit Account settlement payment follows how early the payment is made, counted in calendar days from the day of payment to the balance owed due date:

| Payment made | Ceiling on the settlement allowance |
|---|---|
| at least 14 calendar days before the due date | the program's small-balance write-off amount: 25.00 USD on every deposit program |
| at least 7 but fewer than 14 calendar days before the due date | 15.00 USD |
| fewer than 7 calendar days before the due date, or later | 10.00 USD |

The allowance is rounded half up to the cent and then held to this ceiling.

**Records read.** The balance owed due date on the deposit account, and the handling date on which the payment is made.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, due date 30 June)

| Payment date | Days before the due date | Ceiling |
|---|---|---|
| 16 June | 14 | 25.00 |
| 17 June | 13 | 15.00 |
| 23 June | 7 | 15.00 |
| 24 June | 6 | 10.00 |
| 30 June | 0 | 10.00 |
| 2 July | after the due date | 10.00 |

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** An allowance computed at 21.36 USD on a payment made 20 days before the due date stays 21.36 USD under a ceiling of 25.00. Made 10 days before, it is held to 15.00 USD. Made 3 days before, it is held to 10.00 USD.
